name: formats
description: Money to and from the wire formats: google.type.Money in its ProtoJSON form, ISO 20022 amounts, ISO 4217 minor units and dinero.js objects, exact both ways; what each format can't hold is refused, and malformed input is an error, never a rounding.

provenance.method: The formats' published definitions (google/type/money.proto and ProtoJSON, https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/json/; ISO 20022's ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount and xs:decimal, https://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#decimal; dinero.js 1's toObject, https://v1.dinerojs.com/module-dinero#~toObject) computed with Python's fractions, independently of ducat's TypeScript, with the specs' own examples first.
